attributes.name: Lancashire Heeler
attributes.description: The Lancashire Heeler is a small to medium-sized breed of dog that was developed in England. It is an active and intelligent breed that is loyal and friendly. The Lancashire Heeler stands between 11-13 inches at the shoulder and has a short and dense coat that comes in various colors and patterns.

attributes.name: Bracco Italiano
attributes.description: The Bracco Italiano is a large breed of gun dog that originated in Italy. It is a powerful and athletic breed, with a long, wiry coat. Its head is large and round, with small, erect ears. Its legs are strong and muscular, and its tail is usually docked. The Bracco Italiano is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys spending time with its family.

attributes.name: Teddy Roosevelt Terrier
attributes.description: The Teddy Roosevelt Terrier is a small breed of terrier that originated in the United States. It is a compact and lively breed, with a short, wiry coat. Its head is large and round, with small, erect ears. Its legs are short and powerful, and its tail is usually docked. The Teddy Roosevelt Terrier is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs regular exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys being around its family.

attributes.name: Dutch Shepherd
attributes.description: The Dutch Shepherd is a medium-sized, athletic breed that is known for its intelligence, loyalty, and trainability. This breed is native to the Netherlands, where it was originally used as a herding and guarding dog.

attributes.name: Danish-Swedish Farmdog
attributes.description: The Danish-Swedish Farmdog is a small, energetic herding breed with a short, smooth coat and a keen intelligence.

attributes.name: Small Munsterlander
attributes.description: The Small Munsterlander is a medium-sized breed with a dense, water-resistant coat. It is known for its intelligence and versatility as a hunting and working dog.

attributes.name: Portuguese Podengo
attributes.description: The Portuguese Podengo is a small and agile breed of dog that was originally bred in Portugal for hunting small game. They are intelligent, energetic, and independent, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: Norrbottenspets
attributes.description: The Norrbottenspets is a small and playful breed of dog that was originally bred in Sweden for hunting small game. They are intelligent, energetic, and affectionate, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: Peruvian Inca Orchid
attributes.description: The Peruvian Inca Orchid is a small and agile breed of dog that was originally bred in Peru for hunting small game. They are intelligent, energetic, and determined, and make excellent hunting dogs.
